prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with long dark hair wearing a white long-sleeve crop top and white pants with a tied side detail"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01","P02","P03","P05","P08"],"uncertain":["P06"],"reason":"P01, P02, P03, P05, and P08 all show long dark hair and white long-sleeve crop tops with white pants that have a visible tied side detail (e.g., drawstring or knot on the side). P06 has long dark hair and a white long-sleeve crop top, but the pants appear to be loose and lack a clear tied side detail; the side view is too blurry to confirm, so it is uncertain. P04 has blonde hair, P07 wears shorts, and P06’s pants are ambiguous — thus, they are not matches."}
